specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); user asked to resolve the review screen lock and photo-confirmation error
scope: Operator browser only; preserve server review holds and posting verification
acceptance: A load or receipt held for review displays the existing transaction and a Continue with other orders button in the main screen.
Leaving a reviewed pickup returns to scanning; leaving receiving returns to the order list; durable per-order journals remain available.
A reviewed order cannot resubmit or open its camera while held. Operators can work on unrelated orders.
Leaving an in-progress submission clears only that screen's busy state and timer. A late response cannot change a newer order or overwrite its result.
After a definitive failed posting command, a new attempt gets a new request ID so retaken photos cannot collide with the previous confirmation. Uncertain and attention commands retain their IDs.
Production release changes only Operator browser assets over the current live image and preserves other services and configuration.

failureModel.duplicate posting: Keep server claims and browser journal; block same-order submit; regression tests
failureModel.late asynchronous overwrite: Capture request/order identity and reject stale callbacks; adversarial race tests
failureModel.lost photo evidence: Keep outbox data and original action IDs; rotate only after authoritative failed result
failureModel.unrelated deployment regression: Live capture, narrow image overlay, candidate checks and served-asset hash verification
